## Description and Rationale

Aerospace Engineer with a Master by Research in Aerospace Engineering from Queen Mary University of London, specializing in aviation predictive modelling using ADS-B data.

I joined the challenge to apply my experience in Python, data analytics, and machine learning to a real-world aviation problem and compete with others in the field.

* Type: Independent
